Two months ago I replaced my old Norelco which lasted four years, and bouth this one.  Although I do like the vacuum, the old models had a push out mini blade for the delicate work.  This one doesn't.  None of my older Norelco's ever slipped from their length setting.  This one does, and when it does, it makes me look like I have mowed my face with a weedeater.

reviews.t: not that great of a clipper
reviews.x: This clipper has some design flaws that make it a poor choice for trimming.  My main complaint is that is has 7 settings to choose from but the settings are adjustable by a dial ring on the handle and it is easy to set the trimmer on one setting but have it slip to another setting while trimming giving an uneven cut and closer trim than was desired.  This trimmer needs to have a setting lock or the dial in a different location than right where you grip it.

reviews.t: Tried the rest. This is the best
reviews.x: I've tried others, corded and rechargeable. Nothing beats a Norelco. The vaccum gets about 80% of the hair and cuts better then any other shaver I have had (except other Norelcos.)

As an owner of the previous model without the vacuum, I was looking forward to this new purchase. Bah. This item is heavier, noisier and more inconvenient than its predecessor. And for practically no gain! This shaver catches maybe 10% of the clipped hair with the rest of it flying all over the sink.  Stay away from this model. claims.text: The vacuum feature is divisive: some reviewers find it works well and reduces mess, while others say it only catches part of the hair and is virtually useless.
Several reviewers criticize the build quality, calling the plastic flimsy and complaining about too many movable parts.
Some reviewers report battery or charging problems, including not holding a charge.
A number of long-time Norelco users praise it as the best trimmer they've owned and defend it against complaints.
Some reviewers complain about design flaws such as the adjustment dial slipping during trimming and blades clogging.
